organization.description: The organization where the BigQuery export configuration is created. Format: organizations/[organization_id].
organization.rationale: Defines the scope of the export but does not directly impact the security of exported data.

big_query_export_id.description: Unique identifier for the BigQuery export within the organization.
big_query_export_id.rationale: A valid, unique export ID ensures the correct identification of exports and avoids conflicts or overwriting of sensitive data.

description.description: Optional description of the export (max 1024 characters).
description.rationale: Used for documentation and clarity only; does not affect security of the configuration.
description.compliant: Export of HIGH/CRITICAL findings to security dataset.

dataset.description: The BigQuery dataset where findings are exported. Format: projects/[projectId]/datasets/[datasetId]. Dataset names must contain only letters, numbers, or underscores.
dataset.rationale: Exports should be written to secure and approved datasets. Using unapproved or default datasets can expose sensitive findings.

filter.description: Expression defining which findings are exported. Can include conditions (e.g., severity) combined with logical operators (AND, OR).
filter.rationale: Filters ensure that only relevant findings are exported. Missing or overly broad filters can either miss critical issues or overwhelm the dataset with noise.
